title: Whiteboard Wednesdays brand profile
description: The confirmed brand for one or more named decks. build-trial.cjs refuses a deck whose profile is unconfirmed, not confirmed by the user, or not confirmed for that deck ID.

name.description: Brand name shown above the deck title.

ink.description: Text colour. At least 4.5:1 against surface.

accent.description: Rules, numbers, connectors, active states. At least 4.5:1 against surface.

font.description: Heading font token: hand = Caveat, clean = Instrument Sans, editorial = Fraunces. A new brand font needs the custom-font procedure in references/branding.md.

logo.description: Path to the exact official logo file, relative to this profile. Never a redrawn or generated logo.

by.description: Only 'user' authorises production. 'template' marks an example that authorises nothing.

at.description: UTC ISO time of the user's confirmation.

evidence.description: What the user actually said or approved, and where. Never invented.

decks.description: Deck IDs this confirmation covers. A new deck needs its own confirmation, even when it reuses a brand.
